description: Create or update a shareable zero-login client review and approval calendar link (/review/<token>, up to 20 per workspace on Studio and Pro) so clients can inspect scheduled posts and click Approve or Request changes without an account.

allowFeedback.description: true lets the client approve or request changes with notes on posts. Defaults to true.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

clientName.description: Optional client or stakeholder name shown on the review page, up to 80 characters.

enabled.description: false pauses the link without deleting it.

expiresInDays.description: Optional number of days (1 to 365) until the link expires, or null for no expiry.

id.description: An existing review link id from review_links_list to update. Leave out to create a new link.

locationId.description: Optional location id from locations_list to scope the review calendar to one location or client.

title.description: Title shown on the client review page, up to 100 characters, such as "December Content Calendar".

name: review_links_save
title: Save a client review link
